[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 10: Command and Security Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]10.1[/color] Security and Command roles are expected to know and perform their jobs to the best of their ability. You will be held to a higher standard in these roles. ★
[color=#a4885c]10.2[/color] Both Security and Command are required to know Space Law, Standard Operating Procedures, and Alert Procedures ★
[color=#a4885c]10.3[/color] Don't abuse your position of power, this includes money withdrawal for “payment” upon one self without consulting the payment/hour or transferring your command ship deed to be used outside of your command roles. ★
[color=#a4885c]10.4[/color] You are expected to roleplay with others and respond to situations that need your role to function.★
[color=#a4885c]10.5[/color] If you're in Command, inform your department and Command before cryoing or disconnecting. ★
[color=#a4885c]10.6[/color] Command characters must not have any disability, quirk, or traits that can impede the role function and communication. ★
[color=#a4885c]10.7[/color] Command personnel who signed up for the role but not actively do what the role demands to do (i.e only using the command role for looking at new ship/doing activities that are not within the command SoP) are heavily discouraged and connected to 10.1 rule break. ★
